title: Every pack prints an offline freshness stamp: each cited source's last confirmation and signal, and a mark on a printed fact that is unanchored or older than its source's last change
goal: rag.py pack, kb_pack and the kb: hook print, with no network, one stamp per cited source in the footer (the date it was last confirmed, from the newest of its anchor verified_utc, _fetch_state.csv checked_utc and the census confirmation in version_or_date, and its signal kind: pinned, etag, version, git or hash) and mark a printed fact line whose anchor for a cited source is unlocated (source-dated only) or whose verified_utc predates its source's changed_utc; the stamp adds at most one short line per source, so the eval's mean pack size grows by under 5%; rag.py eval keeps passing every row (D-gmrjivyw: the stamp is always on, offline).

run: import re, subprocess, sys; o = subprocess.run([sys.executable, '_tools/rag.py', 'eval'], capture_output=True, text=True).stdout; m = re.search(r'mean_chars=([0-9]+)', o); sys.exit(0 if m and int(m.group(1)) < 2730 else 1)
